Last updated: 21 August 2026

This file identifies third-party software distributed with the pPreProc
Windows application. Copyrights remain with their respective owners. The
pPreProc Application License does not replace third-party terms.

Applicable copyright notices and license texts are consolidated in this file
in each release archive.

  Observed file version: 5.0.0.93

  Terms: Thermo Fisher Scientific RawFileReader license. The runtime is
  included only as part of pPreProc for access to authorized Thermo RAW data
  and may not be separated for independent redistribution.
  Upstream: https://github.com/thermofisherlsms/RawFileReader
  License: https://github.com/thermofisherlsms/RawFileReader/blob/main/License.doc

Bruker timsdata SDK runtime
  Shipped file: timsdata.dll
  Observed file version: 2.21.104.32-342-vc142
  Copyright: Bruker Daltonics GmbH & Co. KG
  Terms: Bruker SDK terms applicable to the runtime supplied to the project.
  The library is included only for reading authorized timsTOF data and may
  not be separated for independent use or redistribution.

SCIEX Clearcore runtime
  Shipped files: Clearcore*.dll
  Observed product version: 2.0.1020.0
  Copyright: AB SCIEX

  libraries are included only for reading authorized WIFF data and may not be
  separated for independent use or redistribution.

MICROSOFT RUNTIMES

Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime and OpenMP Runtime
  Shipped files include msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll,
  vcruntime140_1.dll, and vcomp140.dll.
  These unmodified redistributable files are deployed app-locally from the
  x64 Visual Studio Redistributable directory and remain subject to the
  Microsoft Visual Studio license terms.
  Information: https://learn.microsoft.com/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files

Microsoft Universal C Runtime and System.ValueTuple
  UCRT files embedded in the Python runtime and System.ValueTuple.dll remain
  subject to the applicable Microsoft terms and notices.
